description_en: Enables or disables the auto-push feature for an image update task
description_zh: 为镜像升级任务打开或关闭自动推送
kebab_example: aliyun ecd update-fota-task --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --task-uid aot-c4khwrp9ocml40000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateFotaTask

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the image update task. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/437001.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 镜像升级任务的信息。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/437001.html获取该参数
parameters.name: task_uid

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically push the image update task.

Valid values:

Running: automatically pushes the image update task.

Pending: does not automatically push the image update task
parameters.help_zh: 设置镜像升级任务是否自动推送
parameters.name: user_status
